neighbours.label: Fires on digital data transfer and connection terms (FTP, VGA/HDMI cables, encoding binary data as text, a data transfer); quiet on physical-world analogues of sending, connecting and storing.
fire: Clients can upload large files through our secure SFTP portal.
Plug the monitor into the PC using a DisplayPort or HDMI cable.
The program stores binary attachments as Base64 text in the JSON body.
All records and metadata are included in the data transfer to the archive.
The camera sends images to the phone over a Bluetooth link.
Backups are copied each night over FTP to an offsite server.
The sensor streams its readings over a USB serial connection.
Large datasets are moved between servers using rsync over SSH.
quiet: Clients can drop off large parcels at our secure front desk.
Plug the lamp into the wall using a short extension cord.
The museum stores old photographs in acid-free boxes in the basement.
All furniture and boxes are included in the move to the new house.
The camera sits on a tripod beside the lake at dawn.
Groceries are delivered each morning by van to the restaurant.
The gardener waters the roses each evening with a long hose.
Large crates are moved between warehouses using forklifts.

predictions: median fire ~0.4 (probes: FTP 0.59, VGA 0.55, 'as text' 0.54, transfer 0.33); near misses < 0.1 (post office 0.02, garden hose 0.05); risk: broad pole (1.1% density).
notes: Top examples: encode binary data as text, secure FTP, VGA or HDMI, metadata in the transfer.
